calculation_handling.description: The interior floor area of a secondary suite, or of all secondary suites together, must be no more than 45 percent of the interior floor area of the dwelling unit in which it is located.
calculation_handling.gaps: The bound is 45 percent of the HOST dwelling unit's interior floor area, which is not a DSL input; writing it with interior_floor_area_m2 on both sides would be circular, so no expression is written and the 45 percent is listed as a value relative to another quantity. No zone is named (Chapter 150 applies wherever a secondary suite is permitted).

units.disclosure: A secondary suite can be at most 45% of the floor area of the home it is in; we do not have your interior floor plan.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 150.10.40.40(1), a secondary suite in the basement of a one-storey detached house may occupy the whole basement.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the 45 percent cap of (1) for this case. 'One storey' is a fact about the house (current_stories) with no condition token; the basement location is a design input.

units.disclosure: In a one-storey detached house, a basement secondary suite may take the whole basement; not evaluated.

150.10.40.40(1).explanation: A secondary suite (or all suites together) can be no more than 45% of the interior floor area of the home it is in.

150.10.40.40(2).explanation: In a one-storey detached house, a secondary suite in the basement may use the entire basement, even if that is more than 45%.
